references.matching_note: Stacks-style commutative ring maps convention preserves identity in this local algebra context.

references.disposition: The g∉q condition is ordinary set non-membership and needs no new named notion.

review_rationale: Reviewed G-unramified-at-a-prime as a property of an unital commutative ring map after localization, linking the prime ideal, localization and G-unramified ring-map meaning in their precise contexts.
